summary: The best numbers file in the app, but its hints need work. Two hints teach wrong case labels ('респондентов' called genitive singular, 'треть' called a genitive ordinal), one hint contains a garbled 'Dюжина', several hints give away the answer, and two hints are written in Russian instead of English.

findings.problem: The hint quotes an English proverb; Russian has its own ('Бог любит троицу').
